reviewed_by: Claude review of the structured-result explorer's narrow-column layout
reason: The explorer renders in the conversation drawer at about 280px inside a wide window, where its viewport-keyed narrow rules never matched: a property row's fixed name column plus the actions beside the value left the value zero width, and its text rendered one character per line. The fix makes the dashboard its own sizing context and keys those rules to its width, and gives a value a minimum measure so the actions wrap instead of squeezing it out. This is presentation only: no component logic, API surface or Core behaviour changed, so the selection is the Playwright area that renders the explorer, extended with a drawer-width regression test that measures the value, the tree and the inspector and fails without the fix. The frontend unit tests for the explorer are selected because they render every view that the stylesheet now sizes.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No Python test is selected because no Python changed: this is one stylesheet, one Playwright fixture and one test. No native tests are selected because no Rust changed. No real-Core entry is selected: layout is identical against mock and real Core, and the drawer's data path is unchanged.
